scope: Additional integrity coverage for completed ordinary-file prefetch reuse after Download Later. No production code changes in this follow-up.
assertions: Destination combo is present
Late metadata preserves user filename and folder
Preview alone never renames the catalog entry
Requested native button is enabled
Explicit adoption preserves the selected folder
Adoption stays a draft until confirmation
Metadata arrived while the native dialog remained responsive
Save commits suggestion and Cancel preserves original catalog name
Preview and Download Later never create destination file data
Existing file rejects suggestion without changing the draft
No header leaves server-name action disabled
Stale metadata cannot rename a changed URL
Real prefetch bytes arrive without publishing before Start
Invalid destination folder preserves the confirmation gate
In-flight confirmation rejects transfer-property edits
Failed durable confirmation restores the original name and publication gate
Start completes ordinary prefetch without stopping its worker
Prefetch never publishes into the original destination after confirmation changes it
Final file exactly matches prefetched response bytes under the chosen server name
Start is clicked while the original response body is still arriving
Download Later retains verified complete response without publication
Completed response receipt survives catalog reopening
Download Later resumes exact completed bytes without another request
Changed completed prefetch cannot publish unverified bytes
Missing completed prefetch fails without publishing a partial file
Reused prefetch still enforces the user's expected final checksum
verified: Missing saved part fails without publishing or issuing another GET.
Modified saved part fails without publishing or issuing another GET.
Changed expected final checksum is enforced even when cached bytes are reused.
Valid saved bytes survive catalog reopening and finish without another GET.
limitations: Controlled native dialogs and local HTTP server; not a new live browser or IDM comparison.
